_schema: items[]: {name, title, batch, replaces (current icons/<x>.svg or null), refs [icons/refs/<file>], brief, drafts [file names in icons/drafts], status: todo|drafted|picked, pick, notes}

items.name: eiffel-tower
items.title: Eiffel Tower (redo)
items.brief: Greg's ref (paris-eiffel.png): straight-on front elevation. Four splayed legs joined by the big decorative arch at the base, a wide first-floor platform band, open gap between the legs up to the second platform, then a long tapering open-lattice shaft to a small top cabin and antenna spike. Show the lattice as X-bracing strokes (it is see-through, not a solid fill), warm bronze-brown (#8a5a3a/#a9783f), deep blue sky optional, green Champ de Mars lawn + tree clumps at the base. Tall portrait viewBox (~60x110). Current icon fails because it is a solid cone with no openings, no platforms and no arch.

items.name: hagia-sophia
items.title: Hagia Sophia (redo, more realistic)
items.brief: More realistic and detailed than current. Real building: big shallow central dome on a drum ringed with small windows, stacked cascading semi-domes and buttresses below it, 4 slender pencil minarets with conical lead caps (2 taller in front, 2 behind), rose/terracotta walls (#e9b88a/#c8664a), grey-lead domes (#9a95a6). Keep minarets distinct at 32px. Wide viewBox (~120x76).

items.name: morro-do-pico
items.title: Fernando de Noronha — Morro do Pico
items.brief: Show the island and the Morro do Pico more clearly: a tall dark-grey rocky spire (thumb shape, slightly leaning) rising from a green forested island hill, beach crescent and turquoise water (#7fc9c2) at its foot, a wave/foam line. Optional red flamboyant tree as a small accent. Must read as 'rock spike on green island' at 32px.
items.notes: Round 2 (Greg): v3 = v2 EXACTLY (copy its geometry) plus a small yellow beach buggy (Brazilian 'bugre', the island's iconic transport) parked on the LEFT on the sand/foreground: open-top boxy yellow body (#f6d26b/#e8b23a), black roll bar, chunky dark tyres, 1-2 surfboards strapped on the roof rack (red + white), a few tiny sticker dots. Keep it small (~1/4 width) so the Morro stays the hero.

items.name: ha-long-karsts
items.title: Ha Long Bay — karsts + cruise boat
items.brief: Cluster of steep green limestone karst islets (rounded tops, near-vertical sides, varied heights, some overlapping in depth) on emerald-green water (#7fc9c2 / #3f8f7a). Add a white multi-deck cruise ship (rounded white bow, 3-4 decks of window strips, small dark funnel/mast) like the ref boat, small relative to karsts. Replace the old red-sail junk.

items.name: milford-sound
items.title: Milford Sound — waterfall fjord
items.brief: Based on ref: a big steep mountain (grey rock top, green forested flanks) with a tall white waterfall (Bowen/Stirling Falls) plunging down a cleft into deep teal fjord water, small strip of shore. Replaces mitre-peak sticker for the nz-southern-alps group.

items.name: pedra-da-gavea
items.title: Rio — Pedra da Gávea
items.brief: Replace Christ the Redeemer. Pedra da Gávea: a big forest-green mountain with a flat-topped bare-granite summit block (tan/ochre #e9c98f + #c38a62) — tall square 'head' on the right, lower flat shelf on the left — over a dark rock face; optional wisp of white cloud at the base and ocean band.
items.notes: Round 2 (Greg): v3 = v2 composition but the rock is more chiselled and detailed, per the labelled ref: the CABEÇA (head) is a big squarish granite block on the right with vertical fracture lines and a shadowed 'face' (two eye hollows = OLHOS, faint nose ridge) on its front; a lower flat MESA/PLATÔ shelf block on the left; a sheer PAREDÃO cliff below the head; layered horizontal strata strokes and facet shading in ochre/tan (#e9c98f, #c38a62, #a9783f). Forest green flanks below, cloud wisp at base. Round 3 (Greg): v4 follows pedra-da-gavea-classic.jpg — tall rounded granite head block with a dark horizontal band, grassy flat shelf to the left, dark rock face, forested right ridge to sea, cloud and grass foreground. v4 rejected (looked like an okaki): head too tall/cylindrical, mountain too squat. v5: steep tall pyramid silhouette, small squarish head at the very peak, flat shelf left, dark rock face left, dense dark-green forest ridge right down to sea. Round 4 (Greg): rock recoloured near-black/slate. Picked v5.

items.name: independence-palace
items.title: Ho Chi Minh City — Independence Palace
items.brief: Wide, low, modernist cream/white 4-storey palace: long flat roof with a raised central block, rows of vertical concrete fins/brise-soleil across the facade, red flag on a pole at centre top, tiny palm trees along the roofline, green lawn with a fountain in front. Wide viewBox (~120x60).

items.name: osaka-crab
items.title: Osaka — Kani Doraku crab sign
items.brief: Giant red mechanical crab sign (Kani Doraku, Dotonbori): bright red rounded body (#d9573b/#c84a2f) with two raised claws and 6-8 long jointed legs splayed out, black bead eyes on stalks, mounted on a white slatted panel backdrop with a dark eave below. No Japanese text. Wide viewBox.

items.name: berlin-memorial
items.title: Berlin — Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe
items.brief: Field of grey concrete stelae in a grid, drawn in simple oblique/isometric so the rows of rectangular blocks recede and vary in height (#c9d4e0 tops, #9a95a6 fronts, #5d5a66 shadow sides). Calm, respectful, no people or just one tiny figure for scale. Must still read at 32px as 'grid of grey blocks'.

items.name: munich-marienplatz
items.title: Munich — Marienplatz
items.brief: Marienplatz: the neo-Gothic New Town Hall (Neues Rathaus) with its tall central clock tower and spiky pinnacles, grey-stone facade with arched arcade, the plaza in front with the Mariensäule column (golden figure on top). Optionally the twin green onion-domed towers of the Frauenkirche small in the background. Portrait-ish viewBox.

items.name: lobitos-platforms
items.title: Lobitos — oil platforms at sea
items.brief: Peru desert coast surf: 1-2 offshore oil platforms (rig deck on legs with a derrick tower, dark steel #3b3640/#5d5a66) out at sea on the horizon, a small white supply boat, a clean left-breaking wave in the foreground; optional tan desert headland (#e9c98f).

items.name: pavones-river
items.title: Pavones — river-mouth landscape
items.brief: Aerial-ish 3/4 landscape: dense jungle-green coast, a river winding out to the sea with a sandbar at the mouth, and long left point-break lines peeling along the coast (white foam lines on teal). Keep it a sticker, not a map: low oblique view.
items.notes: Round 2 (Greg): v3 = v2 river-mouth landscape plus Pavones' famous very long, smooth LEFT-hand point wave: several long parallel white peeling lines wrapping around the point and running far down the coast (left as seen by a surfer facing the beach = peeling from right to left along the shore in the picture as in the ref), clean glassy teal water, sandbar and river mouth still visible, jungle and a small green football field optional.

items.name: punta-mango-barrel
items.title: Punta Mango — barrelling wave
items.brief: A thick, hollow, barrelling right-hand wave: deep green-teal face curling over into a tube with white lip spray, tiny surfer standing in the barrel, foam at the base. Bold silhouette.
items.notes: Round 3 variations, surfer IN the tube (v2 was the earlier pick): v3 = long low wall + whitewater section, like the ref; v4 = wide tube with spit blowing out; v5 = round sunset badge.

items.name: canary-grotto
items.title: Canary Islands — turquoise sea grotto
items.brief: Inside view of a dark volcanic sea cave/grotto: rock arch frame (#3b3640/#5d5a66) with stalactites hanging from the roof, glowing turquoise water (#7fc9c2 bright) inside, light from the opening. Reads as 'cave with turquoise water' at 32px.
items.notes: Round 2 (Greg): v3 based on Jameos del Agua (Lanzarote lava-tube cave): dark volcanic cave interior framing the whole sticker, a ragged skylight opening at the top letting light in, a few hanging rock drips/stalactites from the ceiling, green plants on a ledge at the far back lit by sunlight, and a still, glowing turquoise lagoon (#7fc9c2 + lighter highlights) in the foreground reflecting the opening. Tall-ish viewBox.

items.name: ski-mountain
items.title: Ski category icon — snowy powdery mountain
items.brief: Category icon for Skied (like the surf wave icon): a snowy powdery mountain — white snow-capped peak with powder puffs/snow spray, maybe pine trees at the base, blue shadow side (#9fd3ec / #c9d4e0). Must also work tiny (13-22px) in legends and lists — make v1 a simple bold mark and v2 a richer sticker version.
items.notes: Round 2 (Greg): v3 = a richer ski scene sticker (keep v1 as the tiny category mark): snowy powdery mountain with a gondola cable line and 1-2 gondola cabins, 2-3 tiny skiers on the slope (stick figures with skis/poles), one snowboarder, and crossed skis or a snowboard planted in the snow at the base, pine trees, powder spray.

items.name: blue-heeler
items.title: Paraibuna — blue heeler dog
items.brief: Australian cattle dog (blue heeler): blue-grey speckled/mottled coat (#5d5a66, #9a95a6, #c9d4e0 flecks), tan points on legs/cheeks/brows (#c38a62), big upright pointed ears, white blaze on forehead, sitting or standing alert. Friendly. Optional grassy hill.

items.name: flex-frame
items.title: Playa del Carmen — Flex logo in a wooden frame
items.brief: Square wooden block/frame (warm wood #a9783f/#c38a62 with grain strokes) standing on white sand, with the Flex X mark (4 rounded lobes, use the shape in refs/flex-logo-mark.svg) cut out through it so the turquoise sea and sky show through the hole; a palm tree beside it.

items.name: kinkaku-ji
items.title: Kyoto — Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
items.brief: Three-storey gold-leaf pavilion (#e8b23a / #f6d26b) with dark curved roofs and a little phoenix on top, sitting at the edge of a pond with its reflection, pine trees (bonsai-like) around. Reflection can be a simplified lighter mirrored shape.

items.name: manaus-jungle-hotel
items.title: Manaus — Amazon rainforest + river hotel
items.brief: Dark Amazon river channel between walls of dense rainforest canopy (puffy greens), with a floating wooden/terracotta-roofed jungle hotel on the water (a few stacked blocks, decks, a long pontoon walkway) and a small canoe. Oblique, not top-down.
items.notes: Round 2 (Greg): v3 = v2 but: river colour clearer and brighter (lighter teal-brown/clear blue-green, e.g. #7fc9c2 with #3f8f7a ripples, not near-black), and add a pink river dolphin (boto cor-de-rosa, #f2a3b3 body, long thin beak, small rounded dorsal hump) arching out of the water in the foreground, with a splash ring.

items.name: roraima-kukenan
items.title: Monte Roraima + Kukenán with red trail
items.brief: Two flat-topped tepuis side by side: Kukenán on the left (smaller, steeper, blockier) and Roraima on the right (long, wide flat top), vertical cliff walls (blue-grey #5d5a66/#7d6a5c) over green savanna slopes, a cloud wisp. A little red dotted trail (#d9573b dots) climbing diagonally from the bottom-right up to the top-left onto Roraima's ramp.

items.name: el-toro-barrel
items.title: El Toro (El Salvador) — barrelling right
items.brief: New sticker for the el-toro surf break. Bold barrelling wave in the style of the black logo ref (curling lip with spray, surfer crouched in the tube) but rendered in the atlas palette (teal/sea blues, white foam) and MIRRORED so it is a RIGHT-hander: the surfer rides to the RIGHT of the picture, as seen looking at the beach. Must differ from punta-mango-barrel (more stylised, graphic, rounder curl).
items.notes: Greg's first-ever barrel (right-hander). Round 3, surfer IN the tube: v3 = layered blue tube, rider deep inside; v4 = round badge, curl fills a cream disc; v5 = open wave, rider in the pocket, ragged lip.
